Polygon.description_en:
The polygon formed by a number of points. This parameter takes effect only when the boundary describes a polygon rather than a rectangle.

This parameter is mutually exclusive to the following parameters that form a rectangle: Width, Height, Left, and Top. A boundary describes only a rectangle or a polygon
Polygon.description_zh:
使用若干个点围成的闭合多边形范围，当Boundary描述的是多边形框而非矩形框时有效。

<notice>该字段与Width / Height / Left / Top 四个参数组成的矩形范围参数只会出现一种。即当前 Boundary 描述只可能是一个矩形框或多边形框的一种，具体种类和当前框内容的形态本身一致。></notice>

description_en: Queries face clusters that contain a specific face in an image. Each face cluster contains information such as bounding boxes and similarity
description_zh: 查询指定图片中所有人脸所在的人物聚类列表，每个人物聚类中包含人脸框，相似度等信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm search-image-figure-cluster --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --source-uri oss://test-bucket/test-object --credential-config example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchImageFigureCluster

parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

Specify the OSS URI in the `oss://${Bucket}/${Object}` format, where `${Bucket}` is the name of the bucket in the same region as the current project and `${Object}` is the path of the object with the extension included
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为`oss://${Bucket}/${Object}`，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
parameters.name: source_uri

fields.help_en: The ID of the account that you use to grant permissions
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The RAM role that can be assumed
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:

user: Alibaba Cloud account.
service: Alibaba Cloud service
fields.help_zh:
角色类型，可选值如下。
user：阿里云账号。
service：阿里云服务
fields.name: role_type

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
fields.name: chain

fields.help_en: The policy that is attached to the role specified by the ServiceRole parameter. For example, the policy allows access to OSS. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: ServiceRole参数的角色所需配置的权限策略，例如允许访问OSS。可选
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The service role in the account that is used to call an IMM API operation. The role must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You can configure permissions for the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console
fields.help_zh: 服务角色，调用IMM接口的账号需要创建的一个角色，必须包含 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行配置
fields.name: service_role
